essence: One should abandon initiation, exposition, and lordship before the guru.
Having become a disciple, one should never act together with the guru.
The guru is so called because he gives identity with Śiva, derived from the syllable u.
He is called guru because he removes darkness.
In the Kulārṇava, a householder who knows the meaning of all scriptures is called a guru.
